create_EfficientMask: create an EfficientMask from a numpy ndarray mask with an associated score value
union_EfficientMask: union two EfficientMask objects together and return a new EfficientMask with averaged score
intersect_EfficientMask: intersect two EfficientMask objects and return a new EfficientMask representing their overlap
subtract_EfficientMask: subtract one EfficientMask from another to get the difference mask
check_EfficientMask_overlap: check if two EfficientMask objects overlap above a threshold or are near equivalent
